escapa: As contrações podem passar despercebidas em “what's going to happen”, “we've had”, “it's put us in a place”, “you're at a dinner party” e “Don't you?”. As palavras ligadas tendem a soar como um bloco em “in terms of the future”, “all of the presentations” e “what I want to talk about”. As vogais reduzidas podem esconder palavras curtas em “There have been three themes”, “I have an interest in education” e “what I find is, everybody has an interest in education”.
foco: Antes de ler a transcrição, escute os blocos de palavras e tente identificar as contrações, especialmente “what's”, “we've”, “it's”, “you're” e “Don't you?”.
